user.title: Connect to Vacuula Server
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Vacuula server restoring local control for Neato robots.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Vacuula Server
reconfigure.description: Update the host address or SSL settings for your Vacuula server.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Vacuula server. Verify the host address and port.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed connecting to the Vacuula server.
error.invalid_server: The server did not return a valid Vacuula response.

abort.already_configured: This Vacuula server is already configured.

init.title: Vacuula Options
init.description: Configure polling interval and default cleaning settings.

clean_zone.name: Clean zone
clean_zone.description: Commands a Vacuula robot to clean a specific persistent map zone or room.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Serial number of the robot to command.

zone_name.name: Zone name
zone_name.description: Name of the room or zone defined on the robot's map.

map_name.name: Map name
map_name.description: Name of the floor map containing the zone (optional if zone name is unique).

clean_zones.name: Clean zones
clean_zones.description: Start cleaning one or more room zones or boundary UUIDs on a Vacuula robot.

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Robot serial number (optional alternative to entity_id).

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Room zone name(s) or boundary UUID(s) (list or comma-separated string).

map_id.name: Map ID
map_id.description: Optional floorplan ID (defaults to active floorplan).

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: Optional cleaning power mode (eco or turbo).

navigation_mode.name: Navigation mode
navigation_mode.description: Optional navigation mode (normal, extra_care, or deep).

clean_spot.name: Clean spot
clean_spot.description: Start a localized spot cleaning run (Gen3 robots).

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Robot serial number (optional alternative to entity_id).

width.name: Spot width (cm)
width.description: Width of the spot area in centimeters (default 200).

height.name: Spot height (cm)
height.description: Height of the spot area in centimeters (default 200).

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: Optional cleaning power mode (eco or turbo).

navigation_mode.name: Navigation mode
navigation_mode.description: Optional navigation mode (normal, extra_care, or deep).

refresh_maps.name: Refresh maps and runs
refresh_maps.description: Reload floor maps, room boundaries, and historical cleaning runs from the Vacuula server.

entity_id.name: Robot vacuum entity
entity_id.description: Optional vacuum entity (if omitted, refreshes all paired robots).

serial.name: Robot serial
serial.description: Optional robot serial (if omitted, refreshes all paired robots).

dismiss_alert.name: Dismiss alert
dismiss_alert.description: Dismisses the active notification alert on a Gen3 robot vacuum.

send_raw_command.name: Send raw command
send_raw_command.description: Sends an arbitrary JSON command or ability to a Vacuula-connected robot.

command.name: Command or ability
command.description: Gen3 command name (e.g. getRobotState) or Gen4 ability name (e.g. state.show).
